fusions.name: Fair Warning
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt that deals 6 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Foul Cone
fusions.desc: Looses a reeking cone 5 tiles long, dealing 8 damage to everything in it, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and with a 40% chance of [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spray Back
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Nobody Twice
fusions.desc: When you are hurt, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 10 seconds.
